headline: Georgian Court's goals spread across nine scorers
dek: Nine different players have scored Georgian Court's eighteen goals, more than Post, Holy Family, Jefferson and Dominican have managed between them. Gijs van Eif has five of the goals and five assists besides.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Felician's twelve goals, the most of any programme but Georgian Court, have bought one win against four defeats, with fifteen conceded.

wire.line: Jefferson have lost all five of their matches, and after Georgian Court's defeat at Queens every other side has lost at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bridgeport's draw with Southern New Hampshire is their third against one win and two defeats; they have scored eleven goals and conceded sixteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wilmington's defeat at Queens is their third against two wins and one draw, and they have conceded fourteen goals to eight scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican's home defeat by Molloy is their fourth loss against one draw, and they have still scored only one goal all season while conceding ten.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post have scored six goals and conceded six across two wins, two draws and one loss.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has made 35 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded eight, a save percentage of .814.

last_match.line: Georgian Court have scored in every match this season; Roberts Wesleyan had drawn at home with Goldey-Beacom on their previous outing.

next_match.line: Post's only defeat came at home to Charleston; Georgian Court's came away at Queens, and neither side has lost since.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
